leadText:
Volume 61 is the 61st volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga. It is the seventh volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In VIZ Media's English translation, this volume is published as volume six of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: X•Y".
plainText:
Volume 61 is the 61st volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga. It is the seventh volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In VIZ Media's English translation, this volume is published as volume six of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: X•Y".

==Blurb==
The arrival of Mega Evolution Pokémon, each with more than one Mega Evolution, causes a massive battle to break out at the Pokémon Village! As the X•Y arc comes to a clashing finale, the fate of the Kalos region hangs on the outcome.

Can X and Y defeat Lysandre and save Kalos?!
